crops.place: Autograph and full long return flourish below Le Secrétaire Général; typed name supplies line context.
crops.observed: Two tall cursive forms support E S. The tiny dark strokes following the second letter do not settle whether a compressed surname follows. Retained E S|E Siau. The flourish has two separate long edges from the left return: a steeper edge ascending into the signature, and a shallower edge leading to the far-right return. C draws only one long left-to-right edge plus the short right-to-signature return; a second ascending edge is added.

findings.place: Handwritten autograph below Le Secrétaire Général
findings.evidence: One enlarged autograph crop: first form has upper and lower curls joined by a descending stroke; second has a tall upper turn and lower hooked return. These support E S. A few very short dark strokes continue to the right before the flourish, but no distinct complete i/a/u sequence can be securely separated. E S remains first candidate; the fuller candidate remains unresolved. Typed E. SIAU is not treated as a decisive reading of the autograph.

findings.place: Long autograph flourish: ascending edge from left return into letters
findings.evidence: Half b and the single autograph crop show both long edges meeting at the small lower-left turn. In C the existing path goes from the left turn to the far-right tip and then back toward the letters, leaving no separate line from the letters down to the left turn. Added that observed second edge. This is an added stroke, not merely a change of curve parameters.

notes: The visible side is a typewritten thesis-defence notice headed AVIS DE SOUTENANCE D'UNE THESE DE DOCTORAT DE / SPECIALITE : SCIENCES DE LA TERRE mention GEOLOGIE APPLIQUEE.
The notice is dated MONTPELLIER, le 19 AVRIL 1977, has number N°: 2418 and distribution Liste A, and names BAYER Michel as candidate.

The title is Etude gravimétrique de la Corse. The planned defence is 25 AVRIL 1977 à 14 h. 30, Salle de cours n° 10 - U.S.T.L.; the director is M. LOUIS Pierre and the laboratory is Laboratoire de Géophysique.

The abstract states that 270 measurements completed the gravimetric survey of Corsica and that the whole data set of 720 stations was processed into Bouguer-anomaly, derivative, regional and residual maps, then interpreted with geology and aeromagnetism. These are claims of the notice, not independently verified scientific results.
The abstract explicitly presents the proposed deep structure of Corsica and nearby regions, including the bassin Algéro-provençal, as hypotheses. The research duration is Deux ans.
The proposed jury is P. LOUIS, M. MATTAUER, R. NEUMANN, F. RIMBERT and J. ORSINI, with the titles MM., Mlle and M. placed as transcribed.
The office at the foot is Le Secrétaire Général, followed by an autograph and the underlined typed name E. SIAU. The lower-left pencil 3 is an archive sheet number.
